name: gearset-workbench
title: Gearset Workbench
description: Monitor and operate supported Gearset CI, reporting, and audit workflows from Raycast.
author: jacob

commands.name: ci-jobs
commands.title: Gearset CI Jobs
commands.subtitle: Gearset Workbench
commands.description: Monitor configured Gearset CI jobs and request guarded runs.

commands.name: run-history
commands.title: Gearset Raycast Run Requests
commands.subtitle: Gearset Workbench
commands.description: Review and refresh CI runs requested from Raycast.

commands.name: team-deployments
commands.title: Gearset Team Deployment History
commands.subtitle: Gearset Workbench
commands.description: Review deployments performed by Gearset users across the team.

commands.name: pipeline-report
commands.title: Gearset Pipeline Report
commands.subtitle: Gearset Workbench
commands.description: Review Reporting API v3 deployments for a Gearset pipeline.

commands.name: audit
commands.title: Gearset Audit
commands.subtitle: Gearset Workbench
commands.description: Inspect supported Gearset Audit API activity.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: Automation API Token
preferences.description: Scoped Gearset Automation API token for CI status, run, and cancellation commands.

preferences.name: reportingApiToken
preferences.title: Reporting API Token
preferences.description: Scoped Gearset Reporting API token for pipeline deployment reports.

preferences.name: auditApiToken
preferences.title: Audit API Token
preferences.description: Scoped Gearset Audit API token for team deployment history and audit commands.

preferences.name: ciJobs
preferences.title: Configured CI Jobs
preferences.description: Separate jobs with semicolons: Name|Job UUID|sandbox or Name|Job UUID|production.

preferences.name: pipelineId
preferences.title: Default Pipeline ID
preferences.description: Optional pipeline UUID used by Pipeline Report.

preferences.name: historyDays
preferences.title: Run History Retention Days
preferences.description: Delete local run history entries older than this many days.

preferences.name: historyLimit
preferences.title: Run History Entry Limit
preferences.description: Maximum number of locally stored CI run requests.

preferences.name: deploymentHistoryDays
preferences.title: Team Deployment History Days
preferences.description: Number of days loaded by Gearset Team Deployment History, capped at 90.
